calculation_definitions.monetary_precision: Integer Poisha (cents) accumulation, preventing IEEE 754 floating point drift
calculation_definitions.repeat_buyer_definition: Customer with >= 2 DISTINCT order IDs for the same product within observation window
calculation_definitions.distinct_order_rule: Strict SQL COUNT(DISTINCT order_id); never substituted with row count or summed across buckets
calculation_definitions.observation_window: Earliest recorded sale up to min(first_recorded_sale + 3 years, 2026-05-31)
calculation_definitions.category_benchmark: Arithmetic mean of per-product metrics across all catalog products in category over identical observation window
calculation_definitions.first_recorded_sale_disclaimer: Earliest transaction date proxy; NOT a verified product launch date

data_privacy_and_identifiers.customer_id_retention_reason: The aggregate tables customer_agg_10M.csv and prediction_sample_10M.csv retain pseudo-anonymized Customer_ID values required for account ledger pagination and scatter map coordinates.

segmentation_parameters.scatter_sampling_method: Stratified random sampling (random_state=42, max 1,500 per cluster)
